states.description: État calme par zone, musique basse, ambiance dominante.
Un ennemi a entendu/vu quelque chose, mais pas confirmé.
Danger proche, tension forte, stinger possible.

mix_rules: Enemy audio has priority over music during danger/chase.
Low health adds heartbeat and lowpass filter.
Infection adds cough/breath events that can create noise.
Rain reduces enemy hearing slightly but adds ambient mask.
Metro adds reverb and low rumble.
Laboratory has sudden silence before Subject Omega moments.
